surprises: Standing up the smoke config forced out-of-scope edits to tsconfig.json, tsconfig.build.json, and eslint base.js so build, typecheck, and lint would see, exclude, and correctly treat the new *.smoke.ts files.
createSmokeClickhouse re-implemented createClickhouse's body verbatim instead of delegating to the canonical constructor, the recurring reinvented-helper defect surfacing again.
Each per-filter shape assertion only fires when the filter returns rows, so an empty result still passes while proving only query acceptance.

proposed_rules.diff: + A smoke ClickHouse client must delegate to the canonical createClickhouse(config) constructor, never re-derive buildClientOptions and re-run logger.configure + createClient + createQueryBuilder inline. Reconstructing the client body forks connection setup and drifts from the real client the moment either changes.

followups: P3 Give each filter case one non-empty guarantee where warehouse data allows, so shape assertions verify column mapping and not just query acceptance.
